AbilityDef.description: A player action bound to a key by the client.
AbilityDef.title: AbilityDef

AddPointsFx.description: The only way to change points. Capped at runtime per mechanic/player/day.
AddPointsFx.title: AddPointsFx

Aggregate.description: Fold over a selection; `value` is evaluated per item with `it` bound.
Aggregate.title: Aggregate

Around.description: A position relative to something: random spot within radius, plus offset.
Around.title: Around

EmitFx.description: Fire a custom event (trigger: {on: custom, event: ...}).
EmitFx.title: EmitFx

LetFx.description: Bind vars.<name> for the remaining effects of this list.
LetFx.title: LetFx

Limits.description: Rate limits. Every player-triggered rule and ability needs at least one.
Limits.title: Limits

points_loss_per_player_per_day.title: Points Loss Per Player Per Day

Patch.description:
Modify an earlier mechanic. Path is a JSON pointer; list items can be
addressed by index or by their id/type/name, e.g. /rules/shake_tree/limits/cooldown_s.
Patch.title: Patch

PromptFx.description: Ask a player to choose. Unanswered → `default` option (or nothing).
PromptFx.title: PromptFx

PropertyDef.description: A named value on a player, entity or the world. Resources are player props.
PropertyDef.title: PropertyDef

Selector.description: Query players, entities or zones. Always bounded by `limit`.
Selector.title: Selector

StatusDef.description: Temporary buff/debuff on a player or entity. In hooks, `actor` = holder.
StatusDef.title: StatusDef

TileDef.description: Ground paint. Placed with the `paint` effect.
TileDef.title: TileDef

VoteFx.description: Players vote; the winning option's effects run (actor = each voter for that option).
VoteFx.title: VoteFx

ZoneDef.description: An area with passive properties; fires enter_zone / leave_zone.
ZoneDef.title: ZoneDef

description: One player's mechanic for one day.
